keyDecisions: ADR-039: revive multi-scene as a WIRED feature (ADR-033 retired it only as unwired dead code and explicitly anticipated this revival). 1 scene -> at most 1 output; output shows its assigned scene; unassigned outputs render black.

Live scenes are runtime state in EditorState (the 'active scene of truth'); Project is the serialized DTO. EditorState.scene/quadManager became activeScene()/quadManager() accessors that lazily guarantee >=1 scene.
Default scene auto-assigns to the 2nd monitor at startup (the projector) via a default output created in Application init; F11 lazy-create becomes a no-op since an output already exists.
renderToOutputs(scenes, textures) routes per output via the pure, unit-tested OutputManager::sceneForOutput(); replaces the old 'render all quads to every output'.

Mapping stopgap (ADR-038): a new quad starts 1x1 (no internal divisions); MIN_MESH_RESOLUTION=1. Control grid still doubles as the render mesh, so few-division textured warps are affine until Tier 2 decouples them (user-approved).
Picking must normalize the cursor by glfwGetWindowSize, not glfwGetFramebufferSize (DPI-correct). Handle shader takes u_Aspect to render round handles.
P5 will restore SceneManager/ScenePanel/PreviewPanel + v2 serializer from git 669a05c^ as a reference, wiring them properly rather than re-introducing the inert stub.

Verification method that works on this machine for GUI/mouse/multi-monitor: drive synthetic Win32 input (AttachThreadInput to steal foreground, SetCursorPos + mouse_event/keybd_event) and CopyFromScreen the virtual desktop; cross-check with in-app Logger output.

Build gotcha: cmake --build --target QUADmapper sometimes skips the exe relink after a source/generated-header change; touch the .cpp (and re-run cmake --preset debug for shader edits) to force it. Detect by grepping the exe for a new string.

lessons: Reproduce-first paid off: the reported 'can't drag vertices' was NOT a fundamental picking bug (synthetic-input proof showed corner + mesh drag both work) — the real causes were oversized aspect-distorted handles + an armed Click-add mode that silently suppressed dragging. Don't fix from the bug report's stated cause; instrument and watch.

An accepted ADR's REMOVAL can be the right starting point for revival: ADR-033 kept the Scene primitive, preserved git history, and the v2 read path specifically so multi-scene could come back as a deliberate feature — read the retiring ADR before rebuilding from scratch.

Synthetic Win32 input (AttachThreadInput foreground-steal + SetCursorPos/mouse_event/keybd_event) + virtual-desktop CopyFromScreen is a reliable way to verify GUI/mouse/multi-monitor behaviour headlessly when ImGui menu-driving is unreliable.
cmake --build --target can silently skip the exe relink after a source/generated-header change; verify by exe timestamp / grepping the binary for a new string, and touch the .cpp to force it.
